description: Chiggi Patches v1.14.0 — adds CrazyGames (com.crazygames.crazygamesapp 1.6.7), a Capacitor WebView app: Remove ads neuters the native Capacitor AdMob plugin (interstitial/banner resolve with nothing shown; rewarded ads auto-grant their reward without playing a video), Disable analytics stops native Sentry telemetry, Remove AD_ID strips the advertising-id/Ad Services permissions, and Change app name sets 'CrazyGames Morphe' (package kept so Google/Facebook/Apple login still works). Note: in-page web video ads served remotely inside the WebView are not in the app bytecode and remain. Apps: SonyLIV (com.sonyliv 6.23.1), Nutrilio (net.nutrilio 1.20.2), Threads (com.instagram.barcelona 434.0.0.41.74), Arrow Puzzle (com.easybrain.arrow.puzzle.game 1.7.0), CrazyGames (com.crazygames.crazygamesapp 1.6.7).
